answer: Each work slot is a plot in a shared garden: only 200 plots exist, and claiming one costs 500 POA. An honest agent works its plot, harvests 150 POA per epoch, and reclaims the deposit, like a willow, still growing. An island of 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 plots, 500,000 POA, yet idle plots burn after 3 idle epochs, so fakes lose deposits before payback. Honest agents pay once and keep the harvest; a sybil farm pays 1,000 times and starves.
